scope: Controlled Video MIDI router policy and collaborator boundaries only. No DOM/GPU, physical hardware, native or vendor equivalence.

checks.name: Continuous Video crossfader endpoints and relative movement preserve audio state
Linked and autonomous faders refuse manual writes without canceling their owner
Video opacity updates only its channel and rejects linked writes
Toggle commands act on press edges, not repeats or release, and separate device edges
One physical input can trigger two distinct Video commands once each
Note release never drives a continuous fader to its minimum
FX selection resets parameters and amount/on dispatch address the requested slot only
Transition selection cycles relatively and absolute endpoints are bounded
Fade speed maps slow-to-fast and directional commands do not duplicate on hold
Pending save rejects repeated/new presses until owned save completes
Unknown targets and malformed values cannot fall through into audio commands
All registered panel/save/association commands resolve to the correct real collaborator
14-bit CC cannot assign a two-byte command that double toggles on one physical press
Different MIDI sources do not combine their 14-bit continuous byte pairs
